description: A long-haired, bearded old man in a dark robe walks a rocky mountain path, holding a wooden staff, with a snake coiled around his arm and a large eagle spreading its wings on his shoulder. Behind him rise a tall rock spire, snowy peaks lit by a sunset through stormy clouds, and a dark lake far below. It is a painterly, edge-to-edge scene with no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic or modern.
